title: An agent calling an agent through the gateway
lede: A Remote Agent app fronts an A2A agent with the same sign-in, policy and logging model as MCP apps, and a chain keeps every hop auditable.

edges.label: card is public, endpoint is not

steps.title: Identify the calling agent
steps.what: The calling agent presents an agent key with the a2a scope, selected per remote agent; the agent card is public.
steps.why: An unsigned call got a 401 with a sign-in challenge.

steps.title: Three checks in order
steps.what: Sign-in or a valid key, then a policy covering caller and app, then the app's Auth Mode check.
steps.why: A signed-in user with no policy got a 403; a key without the a2a scope was refused with a message naming the missing scope.

steps.title: Forwarded with the app's credential
steps.what: The gateway forwards on any path under the app; the caller's key is never forwarded, only what the Auth Mode supplies.
steps.why: A chain three agents deep, each hop with its own key, policy and custodian, answered in under a second; an injection was blocked at the first hop.
